name: scamshield-ai
description: ScamShield AI - AI-powered consumer cybersecurity and fraud prevention platform

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @scamshield/shared-types && npm run build -w @scamshield/validation
scripts.build:api: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @scamshield/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @scamshield/web
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run start:dev -w @scamshield/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @scamshield/web
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test -w @scamshield/api && npm run test -w @scamshield/web
scripts.test:api: npm run build:packages && npm run test -w @scamshield/api
scripts.test:web: npm run build:packages && npm run test -w @scamshield/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w @scamshield/api && npm run typecheck -w @scamshield/web
